regressions.issue: Keys are now printed as concat(mem[0]), the scratch word, which is rewritten between two consecutive lines: 'stor0[concat(mem[0])]' on 1812 is validator id's entry and on 1814 the entry of uint16(that entry.field_16), under the same spelling. Exact but misleading; the old text named both keys (8 such lines now, 0 before).
regressions.rule: Print a mapping key read from the scratch word mem[0] as the value of the dominating store to mem[0] (here the id slice, then uint16(stor0[id].field_16)); never print concat(mem[N]) when mem[N] is written between uses.

regressions.rule: Stores at a free-memory-pointer value above the array's allocation (constant floor kept at joins) do not alias its length word; a dominated identical bounds check is dropped.

improvements: 3912 -> 3439 lines, P2 24 -> 12: the custom events (0x224ca655, 0x995a8622, 0x5e3bbed4) show their data, totalSupply/epoch/withdrawalDelay/mint and the validator-share calls (8759c234, 75cbee12) named with arguments, custom-error reverts decoded (0x0d66c00c, 0x5c1ec12d, 0x4e24c9ce, AmountZero), dead memory writes dropped (unknownd07bc162 153 -> 84 lines); the P1 factorisation of the ERC-7201 slot is gone.
notes: Diff of 2,393 lines reviewed by function: calls and events identical in count in all changed functions; event argument renamings (_38 -> _5, _2 -> _1) checked to be the same return values; the +2 Panic(50) in two functions are the repeated bounds checks above.
summary: Many calls, events and custom errors decoded, but mapping keys now print as concat(mem[0]) where mem[0] is rewritten between uses (two consecutive lines name different entries alike), and two bounds checks per loop are no longer recognised as redundant.
